title: Run 1 — the macro plan (Diwali → wedding → home)

steps.text: @planner plan the trip from the brief

Macro plan — 6 days, 2 travelers, ₹60,000 excl. hotels & gifts:
D1–D2 Delhi (Diwali + monuments) · D3 Agra (Taj) · D4–D6 Jaipur (wedding)
Trains: Delhi→Agra 07:00 (₹350) · Agra→Jaipur 10:40 (₹600)
Hotels: 2 Delhi (near Connaught) · 1 Agra (near Taj) · 3 Jaipur (wedding week — see the card)
Closures handled: Taj closed Mon → Agra on Tuesday. Humayun's closed Mon → Sunday. One decision needs you: the Agra detour — card below.

steps.text: Three finds, each backed by 3+ reels. All map to coordinates in the city data — @day can route them.

From the city's own calendar: Diwali Mela & light shows at Ram Niwas Bagh run this festival week (free entry, verify dates with the venue). Also: City Palace has a Diwali evening light-up — worth 20 minutes on Day 5 before the sangeet.
The one expensive decision in this trip: the Jaipur hotel. Wedding-week rate vs the flat Diwali rate — the card: this is the only booking I need your 'approve' for.
